Offline model test fixture: astronaut.png (512 x 512).
Subject: NASA astronaut Eileen Collins. Public-domain NASA photograph.
Downloaded from the scikit-image project's pinned v0.20.0 release:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/scikit-image/scikit-image/v0.20.0/skimage/data/astronaut.png
Public-domain attribution documented by the dataset maintainer:
https://scikit-image.org/docs/stable/api/skimage.data#skimage.data.astronaut
Original NASA Great Images archive reference: https://flic.kr/p/r9qvLn

Used only to validate face detection. Not a student and not a demo school member.
Multi-person tests create a temporary collage from this same public-domain image.
Run python scripts/fetch_test_fixture.py to fetch this development fixture.
